tool_input.command: hops fg create scaled66547d --version 1 --primary-key row_id --online --features "row_id:string,split:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double" --description "standardized features (train stats, population std), train+serve splits" --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Warning | grep -v "^$" | grep -v Logged | grep -v "client version" | grep -v "pip install" | grep -v compatibility | tail -30

mkdir -p .tmp
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabaaa78e_featurestore --limit 0 --json "WITH stats AS (SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2, avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4 FROM rawtrain66547d_1), combined AS (SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM rawtrain66547d_1 UNION ALL SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM rawserve66547d_1) SELECT c.row_id, c.split, round((c.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1, round((c.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2, round((c.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3, round((c.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4 FROM combined c CROSS JOIN stats s" > .tmp/scaled.json 2>.tmp/sql.err
echo "exit=$?"; wc -c .tmp/scaled.json; head -c 300 .tmp/scaled.json; echo; echo "---tail---"; tail -c 200 .tmp/scaled.json
tool_input.description: Run standardization SQL, capture stdout to file

tool_input.command: grep -c '"row_id"' .tmp/scaled.json
cat .tmp/scaled.json | hops fg insert scaled66547d --version 1 --json 2>.tmp/insert.err; echo "exit=$?"; echo "---stderr tail---"; tail -5 .tmp/insert.err
tool_input.description: Insert standardized rows into target FG from stdin

tool_input.command: hops fg info scaled66547d --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '"online|name"|version' | head; echo "=== preview ==="; hops fg preview scaled66547d --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | head -40
tool_input.description: Verify online flag and preview target FG

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabaaa78e_featurestore --json "SELECT row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4 FROM scaled66547d_1 WHERE row_id='R00000'" 2>/dev/null
